prompts.name: apex-m
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG hover letter for a personal gaming website. Generate a single capital "M" as a premium, tactile 3D collectible typographic sculpture unmistakably inspired by APEX LEGENDS. The M itself is built out of red-and-white armored supply-bin panels, black mechanical joints, distressed metal with authentic Apex triangle insignia. Pathfinder's iconic yellow smiley chest monitor is embedded in the central valley; a miniature red-white Apex loot tick with articulated legs perches on one shoulder. A small Wraith kunai hangs from the other edge. These are recognizable Apex props, not generic sci-fi. Strong legible M silhouette must remain dominant. Perspective almost front-on, slightly three-quarter, carefully lit game collectible render, detailed materials, polished editorial art direction, playful physical object, not a flat illustration or simple font with a sticker. The complete sculpture centered with 12% clear margin on every side in a square image. Genuine transparent alpha background, no backdrop, no floor, no cast shadow outside object, no watermark, no captions, no extra letters. Only text is the sculpted M.
